reviews.text: I have used Laura to groom my toy poodle since he was a puppy. Laura is always on time, never cancels and most importantly my dog loves her. It is reassuring when I leave him that he feels safe. Laura does a lovely job every time and he always looks impeccable. Thank you for your hard work Laura, it is always appreciated. I would recommend Laura to anyone that wants a quality and reliable dog grooming service.
Was so attentive and patient with my nervous pooch. Laura was absolutely amazing and so easy to talk to made me and my pooch feel at ease.
Laura always does a great job with my cocker spaniel Sasha. She’s been grooming her for 10 years now since her first puppy groom and she always comes away looking and smelling amazing 🤩 …
My cockerpoo has been visiting since she was a puppy (she’s now 7).  She can be an anxious dog but Laura is great with her and the groom is consistently of a very high standard.  Highly recommended!

Laura is so fantastic with my dog Poppy. My dog isn’t great with people but has always felt happy and safe left with Laura. She’s patient, loving, attentive and always super patient.
Definitely worth the drive and wouldn’t go anywhere else.

My lil dog Barney has been coming to Laura for his pampers for years. After trying different groomers she’s the only lady who has managed to keep Barney calm and happy. His wash and cut is always perfect! Laura does a fantastic job, she is talented, professional and super friendly. I’d never take my pooch anywhere else :)
Staff great but a pig to park !!
